rationale: The implementation delta moves kvm_get_kvm(kvm) before anon_inode_getfd and adds kvm_put_kvm(kvm) on file-descriptor creation failure, ensuring the KVM reference count is balanced on that error path. The Logic section describes common operations—validation, test-mode return, allocation, locking, creation, list insertion, optional initialization, descriptor acquisition, and general cleanup—but does not mention KVM reference acquisition, its ordering, or reference-release cleanup. Its general statement that failures clean up resources is abstract and applies to both versions, even though the fixed version corrects a specific omitted cleanup action.
